result.stdout:
agentspace — AgentSpace 0.1.0

Usage:
  agentspace                          Open the current directory as a workspace.
  agentspace <path>                   Open <path> as a workspace.
  agentspace ssh://user@host[:p]/path Open a remote workspace.
  agentspace open <path>              Send 'open' to the running instance (or start).
  agentspace --workspace <uuid>       Open a saved workspace by id.
  agentspace --ephemeral [<path>]     Don't persist the auto-workspace.
  agentspace --no-auto                Launch the UI without an auto-workspace.
  agentspace --help                   Show this help.
  agentspace --version                Show the version.
